newsitem.title: POLAND: FORECAST-Polish 3-month WIBOR seen at 18.89 end-96.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Polish 3-month WIBOR seen at 18.89 end-96.

text.p: The Warsaw Interbank Offered Rate (WIBOR) for three-month deposits is expected to fall to 18.89 percent by the end of the year from 19.64 percent on Thursday, a Reuter poll of Poland's 25 biggest banks showed.
The prediction is a mean average of banks' forecasts ranging from 18.00 percent to 19.75 percent.

Last month, banks saw the rate at 18.59 percent on average at the end of 1996. It is seen at 19.48 percent on average this month and at 16.85 percent in October 1997. Forecasts ranged between 19.00 and 20.2 percent and 15.30 and 18.50 percent, respectively. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
